Studied: Performance.description:
🎤 You trained to perform: music lessons, a dance studio, a theater troupe, idol training or street performing.

🌱 Voice or instrument, dance, acting and stagecraft, with stage nerves under control. You can hold an audience and read its mood.
⚠️ A professional stage, a hostile crowd or performing while hurt still test you.
⚖️ Street performance may need a permit, and a Quirk used in a show follows the same public-use law as any other use.
🏫 It shows in rhythm, posture and a habit of humming or rehearsing under your breath.

📈 Grants: Performance +15
